params.name: filter
params.description:
The following filter key values are available:

**name** (string): Tax type name 

**description** (string): Tax type description 

**isStandard** (bool): Is standard tax type true / false

**createdAt** (string): format: date-time : Created at, example: `2022-09-13T12:41:18+02:00` 

**updatedAt** (string): format: date-time : Updated at, example: `2022-09-13T12:41:18+02:00`
